description:
Is there any girl you love?

Through these words his friend asked during a school excursion, Kaizu Takumi became aware of his interest in the opposite sex. Of course, there have always been girls around him, like his childhood friend Hatano Konami, his classmate Ebizuka Shino, popular school idol Shimazu Kakana etc. However, he never noticed his feelings until he was questioned by his friend. After growing anxious seeing his friend try to find a girlfriend, he resolves his mind to find a girlfriend of his own during his last summer of high school life.

(Source: Anime News Network)
